disclosure_text: I am an immigrant from India and living here from 3 years.
micronarrative: I read the scenario and felt deep sadness for the bakery owner, an honest, hardworking person who should not be discriminated against for what they choose to celebrate. While this specific event did not resonate personally, it mirrored my own work experiences where I faced ugly stares and felt secretly unwelcome. My one-on-one meetings with my manager were rude and stressful, especially compared to other Americans. This was particularly painful because my manager was from my own country, yet he was polite to local employees while treating me as if I was taken for granted. I did not get into trouble by talking too much, but the experience hurt me deeply. I had to behave like a professional despite the pain. From the moment I woke up, I was in total unrest, counting down the hours until the meeting ended, finding relief only when it was over.
